tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: dpal yang dag thugs kyi snying po las: nyams chag skong ba'i cho ga bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: nyams chag skong ba'i cho ga ni: stegs bu 'dom gang chag chag gdab: dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin bri bar bya: phyag rgya'i sku dang mar me dgu: bum pa chas ldan dbus su bsham: tha mar sman raka gtor gsum brgya: de bzhin mar me tshe dza gad: zla rgyas zla phrom māṃ sa dang: spos dang me tog khur ba bsham: yang na gang 'byor tsam gyis chog: dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla ma dang: dbyer med bsgoms la phrin las gtang: bum pa zla gam gzhal yas su: he ru ka dpal bskyed bzlas dang: las kyi bum par rdor sems bsgom: yi ge brgya pa gang nus bzla: tshogs 'khor bya zhing phyi mchod 'bul: nang mchod stegs la dkyil 'khor bskor: hūm̐: stong pa nyid kyi bhan+dha ru: bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsis bkang: bde stong dbyer med bdud rtsi 'di: bla ma he ru ka dpal dang: rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la 'bul: bdag cag nyams chag bskang du gsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: 'byung nus rtsa rlung bhan+dha ru: phung po rnam shes dbang po bsgral: 'dzin rtog bsgral pa'i rak+ta 'di: bla ma he ru ka dpal dang: rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la 'bul: bdag cag nyams chag bskang du gsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: snang srid snod kyi bhan+dha ru: bcud kyi sems can gtor mar sbyar: lha dang lha mo'i gtor ma 'di: bla ma he ru ka dpal dang: rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la 'bul: bdag cag nyams chag bskang du gsol: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: dbang po tshogs brgyad bhan+dha ru: rnam shes brgyad rnams tshogs su sbyar: sku gsung thugs kyi tshogs 'khor 'di: bla ma he ru ka dpal dang: rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la 'bul: bdag cag nyams chag bskang du gsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: dus bzhi rtag chad bsgral pa yi:

māṃ sa tshe gal zla rgyas dang: zla phrom khur ba me tog spos: snang srid tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di: bla ma he ru ka dpal dang: rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la 'bul: bdag cag nyams chag bskang du gsol: pañca ka ma gu ṇa kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi pho brang du: rang rig lha yi mar me sbar: dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal 'di: bla ma he ru ka dpal dang: rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs la 'bul: bdag cag nyams chag bskang du gsol: ā lo ke pū dzaḥho: dkyil 'khor mthar bkod dbyangs snyan pos: bdag gi 'dren mchog bla ma rje: he ru ka dpal thugs dam bskang: sku yi phyag rgyar gyur pa yi: badz+ra rnal 'byor thugs dam bskang: rigs kyi sras su gyur pa yi: rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs= sku yi phyag rgyar bzhengs pa yi: gau rī dkar mo'i thugs= gsung gi dbyings su bzhengs pa yi: pra mo ha yi thugs= thugs kyi dbyings su bzhengs pa yi: tsaṇ+ḍa lī yi thugs= yon tan dbyings su bzhengs pa yi: tsau 'u rī yi thugs= phrin las dbyings su bzhengs pa yi: bai tā li yi thugs= ye shes dbyings su bzhengs pa yi: puk+ka si yi thugs= gzi brjid dbyings su bzhengs pa yi: sme sha ni yi thugs= dngos grub dbyings su bzhengs pa yi: ghasma rī yi thugs= dbang khrid bshad pa'i bka' drin skyong: slob dpon rnams kyi thugs= lam khrid sa mkhan brtse gdung can: mched lcam rnams kyi thugs= dngos grub ster zhing byin rlabs stsol: yi dam rnams kyi thugs= rtogs pa bskyed cing brtse gdung can: phyag rgya rnams kyi thugs= bar chad sel zhing phrin las can: mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs= legs nyes phan gnod las byed pa'i: lha srin rnams kyi thugs= dpal gyi spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i: ma mo rnams kyi thugs= snying rje'i yul gyur 'gro drug rnams: lha dang lha mor thugs= lan chags bgegs rigs thams cad kun: yi dam lhar gsal thugs= thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni:

rgyu mchog chen po rnam lnga dang: sbyor sgrol sman raka gtor ma dang: 'dod yon rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs: mar me 'od gsal mdangs kyis bskang: hūm̐: dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskang: snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskang: gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskang: sdug bsngal ka dag chos nyid klong du bskang: kun rdzob don dam gnyis med klong du bskang: bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang: mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor: sgrol du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su sgrol: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: skabs 'dir brjod med smre bshags dang khro bo spyi bshags rnams bya'o: mched lcam rnams kyis mar me thogs la: hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje slob dpon gnyen gyis dbu bzung nas: rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob mched dang lcam dral rnams: nam zhig byang chub lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing: ma rig mun pa'i nang du mi 'thum la: gcong rong zab mo'i nang du mi skye dang: dmyal ba'i zangs khar lam du mi ltung zhing: gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad mi grags te: las kyi mtshon rnon dbal gyis mi phog shog: bshes gnyen dam pa bka' drin che ba dang: dam tshig gcig pa'i rdo rje mched grogs rnams: shes rab gnyen gyis 'brel ba'i gzungs ma gsum: tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud thams cad du: mi 'bral 'grog pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: sa bcu rim gyis khyad par bgrod par shog: nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brjes dus byung tshe: ma rig gti mug rmongs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por ltung srid na: gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung: snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'dis:

rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cig: zhai sdang mnar ba'i las kyi sdug bsngal gyis: dmyal ba'i zangs khar lam du ltung srid pas: gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung: snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'dis: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cig: nga rgyal khro gtum khengs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis: gcan gzan gdug pa'i sgra skad thos srid pas: gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung: snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'dis: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cig: 'dod chags 'dzin pa'i las kyi sdug bsngal gyis: gcong rong zab mo'i nang du skye srid pas: gsal ba'i mar me thugs rje der ma chung: snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'dis: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cig: phrag dog zug rngu'i las kyi sdug bsngal gyis: mtshon cha gdug pa'i dbal gyis phog srid pas: snang gsal mar me thugs rje der ma chung: snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'dis: rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cig: sa bcu khyad par rim gyis bgrod pa'i tshe: nyon mongs bag chags ma lus der byang nas: 'gro don thogs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis: sa bcu gcig char rdzogs par gyur nas kyang: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mdun sus shig: byang chub sems ma rnams kyis mtha' skyor cig: khro bo khro mo rnams kyis rgyab rten cig: sa bcu khyad par rtse mor phyin pa'i tshe: phyir mi ldog pa'i dngos grub der thob bo: kun tu 'od kyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis shul mtshon cig: bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mtha' skyor cig: ye shes ting nge 'dzin gyis rgyab rten cig: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la phyin pa'i tshe: gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon cig: mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mthar skyor cig: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rgyab rten cig:

pad+ma can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe: shes rab ting nge 'dzin gyis shul mtshon cig: sgo ba chen po rnams kyis mtha' skyor cig: ta krita chen po rnams kyis rgyab rten cig: 'khor lo tshogs chen sa la phyin pa'i tshe: 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdun sus shig: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis rgyab rten cig: ma tshogs dbang phyug rnams kyis mdun sus shig: bkod pa rab rdzogs sa la phyin pa'i tshe: ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal mthong nas: rig 'dzin rnams kyi zhing du skyes nas kyang: bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: dkyil 'khor thugs ka'i 'od zer ni: rang la phog pas nyams chag bskang: ru lu'i sngags kyis gar stabs bya: 'og min gnas nas rdo rje sems: byon te bdag la khrus byas bsam: yig brgya bum chus khrus bya 'o: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs: bdag la dbang bzhi bstsal du gsol: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad kyis: bdag la dbang bskur mdzad par bsam: hūm̐: ye shes lha yis bum pa yis: ma rig sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams bkru: phyag rgya sku yi dkyil 'khor gyis: bskyed rim lha yi dbang thob shog: snying po sngags kyi dbang bskur bas: rtsa rlung sngags su 'gyur bar shog: bdud rtsi thod pa'i dbang bskur bas: bde stong ye shes 'char bar shog: snang gsal mar me'i dbang bskur bas: phyag rgya chen po rtogs par shog: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ hrī: dbang blang de ltar dus bzhir bya: nyams chag thams cad bskang bar 'gyur: phrin las mjug bsdu gzhung bzhin bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈ sprul sku mchog gyur gling pas sa spyod gsung gi gnas 'og min karma'i dam can brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// dge legs 'phel// //
